title: Fellow in Values Engagement (FiVE) Specialty Proctor for Culture and Community Proctor
bio: Welcome to Hahvahd, Class of 2029!!! After living in Missouri, New York, and now Massachusetts, I’m very excited to be your Proctor this year. I studied Medicinal Chemistry at Mizzou as well as Biomedical Engineering at NYU before working in higher education for over ten years. Currently, I’m the Manager for Student Engagement & Programs here at Harvard University – School of Engineering & Applied Sciences (SEAS). Outside of work, I serve on the Executive Committee of the NAACP Boston branch as well as the Greater Boston National Pan-Hellenic Council. I LOVE good acappella gospel music, comedy, food (let’s definitely grab a meal at Annenberg), traveling, working out, and all things African diaspora. Along with my two precious children Marcus & Janae, we are excited to meet you, build community with you, and just to be a part of your first-year experience at this great institution!!!
